speaker1_bio: Space entrepreneur and founder of Virtual Moon, creating an immersive virtual reality Moon experience to inspire curiosity and the future of space exploration.
speaker9_bio: A futurist, transhumanist writer, activist and speaker. VR pioneer, former European Director of the Foresight Institute, and nanotechnology policy expert.
speaker2_bio: Founder Stardust Inc, private astronaut candidate, and global leader in space education and workforce development initiatives.
speaker3_bio: Cardiologist by profession and President of Astronomical Society of Tunisia, dedicated to bringing the cosmos closer to Tunisia.
speaker4_bio: Space educator and CEO of Univast Space Limited and Virtual Moon Ambassador.
speaker5_bio: Author of the definitive book "A Man on the Moon". One of the world's leading historians of the Apollo program.
speaker6_bio: Veteran of five Space Shuttle missions, including the first Hubble Space Telescope repair. Professor of Aeronautics & Astronautics at MIT.
